sge_root.description: Path to the SGE installation root directory. Set to 'undefined' to auto-detect.

sge_cell.description: Name of the SGE cell to interact with. Set to 'undefined' to auto-detect.

sge_config.description: Path to file containing SGE_CELL and SGE_ROOT definitions.

qsub.description: Path to qsub binary used to submit jobs.

qstat.description: Path to qstat binary used to check job status.

qdel.description: Path to qdel binary used to cancel jobs.

qconf.description: Path to qconf binary used for SGE configuration.

sun_mprun.description: Path to mpirun command for Sun Grid Engine MPI jobs, or 'no' to disable.

mpirun.description: Path to generic mpirun command, used if sun_mprun is 'no'.
